\begin{document}
Let $\eta>0$ and real $\omega$, $\epsilon$. The retarded and advanced propagators of the level are
\begin{equation}
G^r(\omega) = \frac{1}{\omega-\epsilon+i\eta} \qquad G^a(\omega) = \frac{1}{\omega-\epsilon-i\eta} .
\label{eq:gra}
\end{equation}
Their difference gives the spectral function,
\begin{equation}
G^r(\omega) - G^a(\omega) = \frac{-2i\eta}{(\omega-\epsilon)^2+\eta^2} .
\label{eq:spec}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
